name: MARY
canonical: Mary, the young virgin mother, a gentle Hebrew maiden of about sixteen with smooth olive skin and dark hair veiled under a soft undyed earth-toned head-mantle, a serene humble face and downcast reverent eyes, dressed in a simple modest robe of muted homespun earth tones (NO Marian blue), her hands folded at her breast
